name: Gather
description_en:
Gather is a persistent virtual office where remote teammates can see availability, enter conversations and combine meetings with chat and a customized workspace. Its current site distinguishes Gather 2.0 from the older 1.0 model.

That version distinction changes billing: the current FAQ describes 2.0 as member-based, while 1.0 counts concurrent users. A historical per-concurrent-user figure should not be presented as the current cost for a team.
description_zh:
Gather 是持续虚拟办公室，远程成员可查看状态、加入对话，并将会议、聊天与定制工作区结合。当前网站区分 Gather 2.0 和较早的 1.0。

这一版本区别影响计费：当前 FAQ 将 2.0 描述为按成员，1.0 则按并发用户。历史并发单价不能直接当作当前团队费用。

core_features.explanation_en: See teammates, signal availability and join/lock/mute conversations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 查看成员、表示状态，并加入/锁定/静音对话。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure floor plans, team areas, desks and member/guest roles.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置楼层图、团队区域、工位及成员/访客角色。

en: A remote team can create a workspace, invite members, assign desks and establish busy/available norms. Someone needing help can see a colleague’s state and join a conversation. The homepage says users are muted by default and choose which public conversations to hear. Test that behavior with both a member and guest before sensitive work.
zh: 远程团队可创建工作区、邀请成员、分配工位并约定忙碌/可用状态。需要帮助的人可查看同事状态并加入对话。首页表示默认静音，用户选择听哪些公开对话。敏感工作前，应分别以成员和访客测试。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: quick help without a new meeting link
sections.title_zh: 示例：无需新会议链接的临时协助
sections.en:
A remote team can create a workspace, invite members, assign desks and establish busy/available norms. Someone needing help can see a colleague’s state and join a conversation. The homepage says users are muted by default and choose which public conversations to hear. Test that behavior with both a member and guest before sensitive work.

Evaluate a locked discussion and a focused colleague as well as an open chat. Persistent presence does not establish consent to be heard or recorded; define the team policy explicitly. This workspace was not created or tested.
sections.zh:
远程团队可创建工作区、邀请成员、分配工位并约定忙碌/可用状态。需要帮助的人可查看同事状态并加入对话。首页表示默认静音，用户选择听哪些公开对话。敏感工作前，应分别以成员和访客测试。

除开放聊天外，还应评估锁定讨论及专注中的同事。持续在线不代表同意被收听或录制，团队政策需明确。本文未创建或测试空间。

sections.en:
The page displays $12 USD per member per month alongside monthly/yearly controls and a twenty-percent annual discount label. The static view does not clearly bind every repeated price block to the selected cadence, so final checkout must confirm billing. It advertises a thirty-day full-feature trial, not a verified permanent free team plan.

Meeting recording starts at twenty hours, transcription and guest hosting at thirty hours in the shown offer. Unlimited meetings/chat does not erase these pools. Custom plans add options including SSO, larger offices and regional pricing. Confirm guest-hour counting, overages and whether the team is on 1.0 or 2.0.
sections.zh:
页面显示每成员每月 USD $12，旁边有月付/年付控制及年付省百分之二十的标签。静态视图没有把每个重复价格区块清晰绑定到所选周期，最终计费需结算确认。它宣传三十天完整功能试用，未证明团队永久免费。

所示方案录制从二十小时起，转写及访客接待从三十小时起。会议/聊天不限不会取消这些额度。定制方案加入 SSO、较大办公室及地区定价等选项。应确认访客小时计量、超额及团队使用 1.0 还是 2.0。

sections.en:
A team that collaborates throughout a day can evaluate the virtual-office model; occasional client meetings may not justify office setup and ongoing presence. Prepare roles, guest admission, recording access and calendar permissions. Verify which space data and recordings can be exported before adoption.

If someone cannot hear or join, inspect conversation privacy, mute state, device permissions and member/guest access before changing the office model. No device, recording, permission, restore or latency test was performed. A managed virtual space does not establish open-source or self-hosting rights.
sections.zh:
全天协作的团队可评估虚拟办公室模型，偶尔客户会议则未必值得配置办公室并保持在线。应准备角色、访客进入、录制访问及日历权限，采用前核对空间数据和录制如何导出。

成员无法听到或加入时，先检查对话隐私、静音、设备权限及成员/访客访问，再调整办公室模型。未测试设备、录制、权限、恢复或延迟。托管虚拟空间不赋予开源或自托管权。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Final billing cadence, guest-hour overage, version migration, exports, licence and recovery need account confirmation; no workspace test performed.
research_gaps.zh: 最终周期、访客超额、版本迁移、导出、许可及恢复需账户确认；未测试空间。
